issues.on_page: no single governmental cash total printed; lines 271,791 + 235,898 + 5,340 + 158,541 summed, restricted cash 74,252 and restricted CDs 596,708 excluded
issues.issue: Value is derived (marked computed, arithmetic correct), but the 2026-11-06 ruling says cash is filled only where printed and never derived. Excluding the restricted cash and including unrestricted CDs are also the extractor's own choices. beginning_cash is null, so the cash measure has no roll-forward.
The same 158,541 is also counted inside ending_cash, so the two fields overlap.

The category comes from the fund name, not the printed label. The fund-name rule covers a fund's tax receipts only, and miscellaneous receipts are not assumed to be the fund's type. Keno proceeds are likely, but the page does not say so.
